ai_usage_logs_tokens_valid.name: ai_usage_logs_tokens_valid

ai_usage_logs_values_valid.name: ai_usage_logs_values_valid
ai_usage_logs_values_valid.value: "ai_usage_logs"."skill_version" >= 1 AND "ai_usage_logs"."billed_points" >= 0 AND "ai_usage_logs"."duration_ms" >= 0 AND ("ai_usage_logs"."estimated_cost" IS NULL OR "ai_usage_logs"."estimated_cost" >= 0)

brands_json_arrays.name: brands_json_arrays

clients_contract_order.name: clients_contract_order
clients_contract_order.value: "clients"."contract_start" IS NULL OR "clients"."contract_end" IS NULL OR "clients"."contract_start" <= "clients"."contract_end"
